targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(at) AS time, quantile(0.5)(value) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(value) AS p95 FROM s2g.events WHERE name = 'drift_ms' AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT toStartOfMinute(at) AS time, quantile(0.5)(value) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(value) AS p95 FROM s2g.events WHERE name = 'first_frame_ms' AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT toStartOfMinute(at) AS time, quantile(0.5)(value) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(value) AS p95 FROM s2g.events WHERE name = 'join_ms' AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT detail AS video, toString(value) AS code, count() AS failures FROM s2g.events WHERE name = 'player_error' AND $__timeFilter(at) GROUP BY video, code ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 50
